name: [Negative] Cashback for Bill/UPI Payments Not Credited / Forced US Stocks Investment
description: Users report that cashback rewards advertised for bill and UPI payments are either not credited, are unavailable, or redirect them to US stock purchase pages. The app requires creation of a US stock account and a minimum investment to claim cashback, which contradicts earlier claims that cashback could be earned on any bill payment.

name: [Negative] Misleading Cashback & US Stock Requirement
description: Users report that the app’s advertised cashback for bill and UPI payments actually redirects to US stock purchases, with rewards credited as stock points instead of cash or clear rewards, and requires users to open a US‑stocks account and meet investment thresholds that are not disclosed upfront.
